description: Phase 66 condition fixture: a Rome-Persia campaign exhausts from real war duration before its offensive deadline, obtains a normal AI ceasefire, and enters recovery.
luaCommands: lua cmd local rome=find.player(4); local persia=find.player(6); local city=nil; for c in persia:cities_iterate() do if c.name == "Parsa" then city=c end end; persia:add_love(rome, 1000); edit.ai_strategy_set_organic(rome, "prepare", "city", persia, city, 786, 6000, 671, game.current_turn() + 3, 166001, -1); edit.make_contact(rome, persia)
name: phase66_condition_exhaustion_spike
